_provenance: Recommended `tuning` object for Kopia's native Google Drive backend.
HOW TO USE: copy this document into the "tuning" key of a gdrive connection
config (repo/blob/gdrive.Options). The "_provenance" key is not a knob; it is
ignored, because blob.ConnectionInfo.UnmarshalJSON decodes the config with a
plain json.Unmarshal and never calls DisallowUnknownFields. Verified live: a
targets file whose tuning object carried _provenance plus a nonsense knob
loaded without error. The same tolerance means a MISSPELLED knob is silently
ignored - after editing, confirm the value took effect by reading
targets[].knobs in the next gdrive-bench result document.
STATUS 2026-08-02: every value below is the backend's own built-in default.
No knob has yet been measured to beat its default on real Drive. That is a
result, not an omission - see tools/gdrive-bench/TUNING.md for the process
and $KOPIA_GDRIVE_BENCH_RESULTS/TUNING_LOG.md for every cycle, including the
rejected ones. A value here without a provenance line naming a run is a
guess and the next cycle should delete it.
PER-KNOB PROVENANCE:
pacerMinSleepMS=100     DEFAULT RETAINED. Cycle 1 (2026-08-02, run
20260802T083645Z-tuning-cycle-1-pacer-minsleep.json)
tested 100 -> 50 against a control in one 5-trial ABBA
interleaved run over small-write, read-metadata and
delete-sweep. Every row NOISE, zero REAL, identical
Drive call mix and quota, zero errors on both lanes.
REJECTED. Mechanism: the pacer is a token bucket of
rate 1/minSleep with burst pacerBurst, and none of
these workloads draws tokens faster than the bucket
refills, so minSleep never binds.
pacerBurst=100          DEFAULT, UNMEASURED. Inherited from rclone's Drive
backend (RECON R2). Cycle 1 argues this is the more
promising half of the pacer pair; not yet tested.
pacerMaxSleepMS=16000   DEFAULT, UNMEASURED. Only observable while actually
being rate limited, which no benchmark run has been.
A Retry-After from Drive is honored uncapped anyway.
maxTries=10             DEFAULT, UNMEASURED. Affects tail latency only under
errors; every run so far has had zero.
uploadChunkSizeMB=64    DEFAULT, UNMEASURED. Priority-queue item 3.
simpleUploadCutoffMB=8  DEFAULT, from rclone's measured Drive cutoff (RECON
R2). At the 2-8 KB and 20 MB blob sizes benchmarked
so far this selects simple upload for small blobs and
resumable for packs, which is the intended split.
listPageSize=1000       DEFAULT = the Drive API maximum. Phase 3 data says
listing is latency-bound, not page-bound (a whole-
storage traversal is ~200 ms), and a smaller page
would cost strictly more quota (100 QU per page).
Lowering it has no plausible upside.
deleteParallelism=8     DEFAULT, UNMEASURED as a sweep, but the parallel-
singles path it bounds was measured in Phase 2e at
19.5-23 blobs/s against 8.6 for batch deletes.
Priority-queue item 2.
useBatchDelete=false    MEASURED, Phase 2e (see PROJECT_STATE.md): Drive runs
the parts of a homogeneous batch serially, making
batch deletes ~2.5x SLOWER than parallel singles.
Keep false. The knob exists to be re-measured, not
as a recommendation.
cacheDir                DELIBERATELY ABSENT. The platform cache directory is
the right default; set it only to move the blobID-to-
fileID journal onto specific storage. gdrive-bench
sets it per lane purely to isolate benchmark runs.
